biography: Nagendra Pavana is a Sanskrit scholar whose work focuses on Vyākaraṇa, Sanskrit literature and Indian knowledge systems. His education combines gurukula training with a doctorate in Vyākaraṇa from Karnataka Samskrit University. He has taught Sanskrit grammar, contributed to digital Sanskrit learning resources and co-authored Introduction to Indian Knowledge System: Concepts and Applications.
researchOverview: His scholarly interests include Pāṇinian grammar and the Mahābhāṣya, Sanskrit poetry and aesthetics, Indian philosophical traditions, the Vedas and Vedāṅgas. His educational work also includes Sanskrit e-learning resources.
